name: Basic Ear Training Exercises
instructions: Ear training builds your ability to recognize notes, intervals, and chords by sound alone -- a skill that compounds over months of practice.
Try playing two notes and guessing whether the second is higher or lower before checking -- the simplest possible ear-training exercise.
Sing back a note you just played on the guitar; connecting your voice to what you hear strengthens the skill faster.
Watch today's video for basic ear training exercises for complete beginners.
